name: normlike
expr: nL_basic = normlike([3, 1.5], x); nL_cens = normlike([3, 1.5], x, cens); nL_freq = normlike([3, 1.5], x, [], freq); nL_both = normlike([3, 1.5], x, cens, freq); nL_empty = normlike([3, 1.5], []); nL_sig0 = normlike([3, 0], x);
comment: Sig: nL = normlike([mu sigma], data[, cens, freq]). Default + censoring (right-censored => -log(S(z))) + freq weights + empty + invalid-sigma (=> NaN). Second output `avar` (inverse observed-Fisher info) NOT implemented — MATLAB compatibility holds for one-output form only.
